answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit bond in the canyon vault and buys one tide pool verification to count its work. The pool posts one price for all: the k-th identity verified this epoch pays 20 + 0.02(k-1) credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 in bonds plus 29,990 in prices. Splitting wallets gives no discount: the price tracks pool occupancy, not any wallet. A quill clerk signs each receipt binding key and work hash; reuse fails the check and burns the bond. One tide pool serves each epoch, so new wallets cannot reset it. An honest identity pays once and reclaims its bond after a clean epoch.
